recent.text: “I thought they were both great. I played with (Jones) in New York a lot, and I know how good of a hockey player he is, and he put it on display tonight. And (McCartney) was great too.” -Trocheck on Jones and McCartney making their Utah debuts
recent.author: Catherine Bogart

recent.text: “We've been getting better every night throughout the course of the year...we stuck to our plan the whole game and didn't get away from it. Played hard in the D zone. (Tourigny) always talks about pace, and I thought our pace was great.” -Vincent Trocheck on UTA defensive effort
recent.author: Catherine Bogart

recent.text: Good stuff from Zac Jones after the game today. He’s an easy guy to cheer for. #TusksUp
recent.author: Brogan Houston
recent.quoted_text: Move over, RSL. There’s a new ‘soccer’ team in town Story by @houston_brogan https://t.co/f5nolhv4pz

recent.text: The Mammoth are now on a four game losing skid. However, while no loss should be celebrated, Thursday’s 65 minute and eight round shootout loss to the Blues is the closest it gets to that. #TusksUp https://t.co/rFv3bnHTZI
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: Both Liam O’Brien and Ben McCartney saw very limited ice time tonight. Tourigny said it was a coach's decision rather than injury-related, but it wasn't because they did anything wrong. It was about the momentum and not wanting to put someone in cold. #TusksUp
recent.author: Brogan Houston

recent.text: POSTGAME "If I could talk about all our players that I liked tonight, we’d be here for a while... It’s the leaders who bought in and everybody else bought in. And that’s why they play(ed) that hard." @utahmammoth André Tourigny on the team's leadership group https://t.co/rjxoehLsyq
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: POSTGAME "The guys that played I thought did a great job of just sticking to our roles, and honestly, we played a great game today. Credit to their goalie, he played well, and it's the way it goes sometimes." @utahmammoth Zac Jones on tonight's performance https://t.co/dLFWXq4F4o
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: POSTGAME “We played hard, defended really well. Obviously, it goes on to a shootout, but the way we responded on a back-to-back with the amount of injuries that we've had in the last couple days is definitely a positive.” @utahmammoth Vincent Trocheck on tonight's game https://t.co/9nkF8MwmG2
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: Postgame Notes - 11/12 vs. STL: – The Mammoth played the fourth 1-0 game in franchise history tonight, earning a point for the first time. – Karel Vejmelka stopped all 22 shots faced in regulation and overtime to register his second shutout of the season and 10th of his career. https://t.co/U5x6Zi9w5O
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: Even though the Mammoth lost, Karel Vejmelka still gets credit for a shutout tonight because his save percentage was 1.000. (If you don't believe me, check the NHL stats website. It lists 2 shutouts on the season for him.) #TusksUp #STLBlues
recent.author: Brogan Houston

recent.text: 3 stars of the game: ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Vejmelka's posts ⭐️⭐️ Connor McMichael for ending it ⭐️ All the fans who stuck this one out #TusksUp #STLBlues
